_note: World Bank indicator codes rotated by daily_facts.py (date-seeded permutation, separate seeds for the UK and Jamaica). Editing this list mid-cycle reshuffles the rotation once. format: usd | pct | count.

indicators.label: GDP (current US$)
indicators.meaning: The total market value of everything the economy produced in a year, converted to US dollars at market exchange rates.

indicators.label: GDP growth (annual %)
indicators.meaning: How much the economy grew in real terms, i.e. after stripping out inflation.

indicators.label: GDP per capita (current US$)
indicators.meaning: Output per person: a rough gauge of average living standards, before adjusting for local prices.

indicators.label: GNI per capita, PPP (current international $)
indicators.meaning: Income per person adjusted for what money actually buys locally (purchasing power parity), so countries compare more fairly.

indicators.label: Consumer price inflation (annual %)
indicators.meaning: How fast the prices of a typical household basket of goods and services rose over the year.

indicators.label: Unemployment (% of labour force, ILO modelled estimate)
indicators.meaning: The share of people available for and seeking work who don't have a job.

indicators.label: Labour force participation (% of population 15+, ILO modelled estimate)
indicators.meaning: The share of adults who are either working or actively looking for work.

indicators.label: Central government debt (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: What the central government owes, measured against one year of the country's total output.

indicators.label: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: How much of the economy's output is sold abroad: a measure of openness to trade.

indicators.label: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: How much the economy buys from abroad, relative to its own output.

indicators.label: Services, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: The share of output from services such as finance, retail, tourism, health and education.

indicators.label: Industry incl. construction, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: The share of output from manufacturing, mining, utilities and construction.

indicators.label: Agriculture, forestry and fishing, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: The share of output from farming, forestry and fishing.

indicators.label: Personal remittances received (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: Money sent home by people working abroad, relative to the size of the economy.

indicators.label: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
indicators.meaning: New long-term investment by foreign companies and investors into the economy, relative to its size.
